From: Anna Li <security@bluearc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence gateway and delegated owners for BlueArc audit

Hi Marissa,

We're kicking off our CSA/CAIQ review for Redwood (scope: inference runtime, tenancy boundaries, telemetry retention) and our compliance team needs a lightweight ingestion process for evidence. Audit window is tight — target kickoff in two weeks (2027-05-25).

Can you do the following?
- Provide a single secure ingestion point or short-lived link where we can pull artifacts (logs, config extracts, attestations).
- Share a delegated owner roster (who will own each control family and artifact).
- Confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a temporary SLA exception for log retention snapshots (we'll provide exact control IDs; we need 30 days of historical logs that might normally be on cold storage).

I've attached a scope workbook (bluearc_caicq_scope.xlsx) with our initial control list. If you can send an owner mapping + proposed gateway by EOD Friday 2027-05-14, that will keep us on schedule.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Anna Li
Security Program Manager
BlueArc
attachments: bluearc_caicq_scope.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <security@bluearc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence gateway and delegated owners for BlueArc audit

Hi Anna — thanks for the scope workbook and heads-up. We can support a short ingestion window and provide delegated owners for each CAIQ control family. High-level proposal below; detailed owner roster and transient access instructions attached.

Proposal (summary):
- Evidence gateway: secure, time-limited SFTP endpoint + per-file signed URLs for large archives. We will provision transient credentials and rotate after the collection window.
- Owner roster: we will assign owners per control family (see attached). Kimberly will lead Logging & Monitoring artifacts; Ben will lead Key Management & Cryptographic controls; I will remain the liaison for the audit and escalations.
- SLA exception: we can provide a documented SLA exception for a 30-day retention snapshot. This will be delivered as a PDF attestation and temp access to the cold-storage export.

Next steps / asks from BlueArc:
1) Confirm the list of control IDs you plan to validate from the attached workbook (we flagged the items we think are in-scope).
2) Confirm whether you prefer SFTP pull or pre-signed URL push for large log bundles.
3) Provide primary contact for ingest operations (ops@bluearc.com or a named single point).

Attached: redwood_sla_exception.pdf (draft), access_transient_key.txt (instructions and key thumbprint). We'll follow up internally to populate the per-control owner matrix by tomorrow EOD.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
attachments: redwood_sla_exception.pdf; access_transient_key.txt
